accents.$description: The accent axis, light resolution. Two roles, not one ramp step: --accent is a FILL and must carry --on-accent at >=4.5; --accent-2 is TEXT and must clear 4.5 on --bg and --elevated. That is why the steps are not uniform — indigo, blue and rose reach the fill floor at -600 while teal, green and amber only reach it at -700 (teal-600 measures 3.72 against white, green-600 3.27, amber-600 3.21). Every accent is written out in full rather than as a partial override of the dark block: the file is the cascade already resolved, so nothing re-derives it. --accent-away is black for all six because every light fill takes white ink; it is the pole --accent-hover (theme.light.json) mixes toward.

indigo.$description: Default accent. Fill indigo-600 (6.44 with white ink), text indigo-700 (8.07 on --bg).

teal.$description: Fill teal-700 (5.44), text teal-800 (7.55). Teal needs -700 for the fill; -600 measures 3.72 with white ink.

green.$description: Fill green-700 (4.99), text green-800 (7.09). green-600 measures 3.27 with white ink.

amber.$description: Fill amber-700 (5.07), text amber-800 (7.14). amber-600 measures 3.21 with white ink — the worst of the six.

accent.$description: The active accent. Defaults to indigo.

accent-2.$description: The text-safe accent step: lighter than --accent in dark, darker in light. --accent is a fill and is not guaranteed to clear 4.5 as text.

accent-away.$description: See the dark file: --accent-hover substitutes this, so it must be defined before any [data-accent] block matches.
